description: Figure 16c is a line plot with the x-axis labeled "Initial Confidence" and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy". The plot has three lines, each representing a different dataset. The blue line represents the "Final Accuracy" dataset, the green line represents the "Initial Accuracy" dataset, and the orange line represents the "Δ Accuracy" dataset. The plot shows that the final accuracy is generally higher than the initial accuracy, and that the Δ accuracy is generally lower than the final accuracy. The plot also shows that the accuracy tends to decrease as the initial confidence increases.
